Just want to share this because seeing AHOF being acknowledged like this by SM Mall of Asia — one of the biggest corporations in the PH — feels huge.  

For a 5-month rookie group, this kind of recognition doesn’t happen by accident. The impact is real, the demand is visible, and the noise is undeniable.

Not saying anything… but it really feels like a preamble.  
Manifesting an AHOF concert in Manila — and why not dream big?  
MOA Arena, 2–3 days. ✨

From organic support to moments like this — look how far we’ve come.  
#AHOF #아홉 #FOHA
